items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Dway Jackson had the band on that same boat. Dway Jackson was at that same time? That's right. See, Charlie Crep was in the band.

ctx.x: What was there much difference in what you call the St. Louis style? And... No, no, no. Anything special about the St. Louis players? I've heard Charlie Crep is a wonderful blues player. That's right, you see. He's really exceptional on the blues.

Well, he was really top-zone blues and he had a good tone. He was one of the few jazz trumpet players that had a good, what we call a concert tone, a good solid tone. I see, of course, you know, during that time, you know, during the daytime, or, uh, Dway Jackson had the band on that same boat. Dway Jackson was at that same time? That's right. See, Charlie Crep was in the band.
Who else was in Charlie Crep's band? Can you remember even just two or three of them? Well, there was...
